title: More pre-registered claim tests
headline: 12 new pre-registered claim tests this hack: 5 supported, 3 refuted, 2 mixed, 2 blocked on Dryad downloads. Covers 8 proved math-bio laws plus 4 Darwin and Thompson claims; 16 tests on the site in all, every one with checksummed public data. Hub's readings check on the two refutations is done and both verdicts stand.
blockers: Dryad (datadryad.org) blocks scripted downloads with a proof-of-work challenge; two pre-registered tests (hamilton-lmc, maynardsmith-war-of-attrition) stay inconclusive until someone downloads 3 small files in a browser into their data/ folders.

needs.ask: Download DryadData.xlsx (doi:10.5061/dryad.15nj0) into claim-tests/math-bio-theorems/hamilton-lmc/data/ and fight.csv + README.md (doi:10.5061/dryad.bg79cnpjg) into claim-tests/math-bio-theorems/maynardsmith-war-of-attrition/data/, then tell me; fetch.py records the checksums and the pre-registered analysis runs unchanged.
Approve one branch for the whole tree so the local commits on main (claim-tests/ and dashboard/public/t/claims/) can be pushed; nothing is pushed until then, per the hub.

next: More Darwin/Thompson tests from the swarm's verified drafts if time allows (candidates: MDD island mammals, DATRAS plaice condition factor, VertLife rabbit-rhinoceros phylogeny)
